ITEM 1 | Pale cream-yellow florets, bite-sized, with golden-brown roasted edges and dark char spots on some pieces; dry-looking surface with slight sheen, some pieces with small clusters of stems; scattered across the left-center of the plate covering roughly 40% of the plate area, piled 1-2 cm high in places | 110
ITEM 2 | Bright green wedges with pale yellow-green flesh, smooth glossy skin edge visible on outer rim, soft-looking fleshy surface; three slices lying on the lower right of the plate, each about 5-7 cm long and 2-3 cm wide, covering roughly 12% of the plate area, about 2 cm thick | 90
